definitions.explanation: The achievement of a desired goal or favorable outcome.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{成功|せいこう}だった。
{彼|かれ}は{仕事|しごと}で{大|おお}きな{成功|せいこう}を{収|おさ}めた。
examples.english: He achieved great success in his work.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}するかどうかは、やってみないと{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: You won't know whether it will succeed until you try.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}は{成功|せいこう}の{元|もと}という{言葉|ことば}があるように、{失敗|しっぱい}から{学|まな}ぶことは{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: As the saying 'failure is the mother of success' suggests, learning from failure is important.

notes:
{成功|せいこう} is the general word for success and achievement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {成功|せいこう}する (to succeed)
- {成功|せいこう}を{収|おさ}める (to achieve success)
- {成功|せいこう}に{導|みちび}く (to lead to success)
- {成功|せいこう}を{祈|いの}る (to wish success)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {成功|せいこう}{者|しゃ} (successful person)
- {成功|せいこう}{例|れい} (success story)
- {大|だい}{成功|せいこう} (great success)

PROVERBS:
- {失敗|しっぱい}は{成功|せいこう}の{元|もと} (Failure is the mother of success)

ANTONYM:
- {失敗|しっぱい} (failure)
